The mechanism is verifiable: the loop body has no rescue, and TopicEmbed.import only guards on URL format, not content. However, whether a malformed feed item is realistic enough to call it a definite defect is somewhat uncertain, so mid confidence.

adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, rss.items.each do |i| processes items without any per-item rescue. The code calls i.content.scrub and TopicEmbed.import(...) (which can raise, e.g., nil i.content => NoMethodError, network/DB/PostCreator exceptions, or create! failures). Any exception will abort the loop and, because TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve calls Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({}) synchronously when feed_polling_enabled, it can also abort the TopicRetriever retrieval path before falling through to fetch_http.
